Every Detail, Thoughtfully Designed
What is the Momcozy Wellness 1 warm-massage breast pump and why do the warmth and massage features help with milk flow?
The Momcozy Wellness 1 (Momcozy W1) is a warm-massage breast pump. It is the first wearable pump to use our industry-first rhythmic massage and wraparound warmth. This combined approach is key:
1. The gentle heat relaxes your breast tissue and milk ducts, just like a warm compress.
2. The rhythmic massage breast pump uses soothing vibrations to mimic a baby’s natural touch. This helps your body release oxytocin—the hormone needed for milk let-down—making the milk flow smoother and faster.
How does the heating feature on the Momcozy W1 work, and is it a safe heated breast pump?
The Momcozy W1 has an industry-first wraparound warmth design. This heat feature works like a built-in warm compress on the flange area. It gives wide, gentle, comforting warmth that helps your breast relax and respond naturally. The temperatures are very carefully controlled to be safe.
What is the difference between the Momcozy W1 and the Air 1?
The Momcozy Wellness 1 represents a significant shift from the Air 1. The major improvement in the W1 is the inclusion of the industry-first integrated heat and advanced rhythmic vibration massage pump technology, which the Air 1 lacks. In contrast to the Air 1, which features app connectivity and a charging case, the Momcozy W1 focuses purely on wearable comfort, warmth, and massage and app enabled but doesn't include charging case. The core benefit of the Momcozy W1 is the therapeutic warm-massage breast pump experience.
How does the Momcozy W1 compare to a standard pump?
The Momcozy W1 is both a powerful wearable pump and a heated breast pump. Standard pumps only use suction. The Momcozy W1 adds our rhythmic massage and wraparound warmth. People call it the ultimate warm-massage breast pump because the heat and massage relax your body for better milk expression.
Has the Momcozy Wellness 1 been tested for safety and does it have certifications?
Yes, absolutely! We tested the motor and all parts of the Momcozy Wellness 1 very carefully. Experts checked them to make sure they are safe, strong, and will last a long time. Rest assured that this warm-massage breast pump complies with all relevant safety standards and certifications, making it a reliable tool for your entire feeding journey.
Does the pump come with accessories or spare parts?
Yes, the Momcozy W1 includes all essential parts you need to start pumping right immediately. We also include different inserts for the flanges to meet various sizing needs, ensuring you get the perfect fit for your warm breast pump.

We also offer other spare parts (like valves or collection cups) for separate purchase.
Does the Momcozy W1 require an app to work?
The Momcozy W1 offers total flexibility and can be used with or without an app . While the built-in LED display allows for easy manual adjustments, connecting to the app provides smart control right from your phone so you can adjust suction, warmth, and massage without needing to fumble under your blouse. Additionally, you can access expert modes ready in one tap that are specifically designed to support milk flow and make late-night pumping sessions much easier to handle.
Does W1 come with a charging case?
The W1 does not include a separate charging case, but its built-in battery power is so strong that it matches the performance of pumps with a case .
It features a high-capacity 2200 mAh battery , which is much larger than many other wearable pumps. This design allows the W1 to be powerful yet simple to carry.
On a single full charge, the W1 provides industry-leading runtime:
Up to 10 sessions (Standard Mode) — for reference, some pumps with charging cases offer around 15 sessions in total, making the W1’s 10-session standalone power very impressive.
Up to 6 sessions (Warm-Massage Mode)
This high-capacity design ensures you have enough power for both day and night use without needing to carry a bulky extra charging case.
Is there a carrying or travel bag included?
W1 does not include a dedicated carrying or travel bag by default.
Its compact design makes it easy to store in most personal bags, backpacks, or baby bags.

The best Momcozy pump I have tried!
The Wellness 1 is such an amazing pump! The heat and vibration makes the pumping experience so much more relaxing and even increased my output. The smart features are so helpful and I love the clear tunnels this pump helps so much to be able to be mobile and juggle the demands of everyday mom life.

I had the Momcozy M5 but got this pump because my M5 seemed to be dying. The wellness 1 is amazing. I felt uncomfortable pumping but the vibrations and warmth on the wellness 1 made me feel more comfortable during pumping. I definitely feel like I release more milk and at a faster rate with the wellness 1.
I’m glad I bought it but it is definitely more work to put together and take apart than the M5. I will say that it does leak if you try to slightly bend over. I lose less than with my M5 since this one has a cover but it definitely still leaks. Still a great purchase. I wish I had started with this pump.
I have tried other wearable pumps that have not worked for me at all! I enjoyed my wellness ones because I feel like I get emptied extremely well! These are great to wear for me while working and you cannot tell!
My Momcozy W1 is by far my favorite pump, it empties me as well as my wall pump but is completely hands free not to mention super comfortable! As an exclusively pumping mom it’s super important that I’m able effectively and efficiently fully empty myself every pump and the W1 does that! I have another pump that has similar features but this one is my favorite. It’s completely customizable both on the pump itself but also in the app so if you decide you don’t want heat or vibration you can turn it off. It also has a few pre programmed pump sessions that change modes between stimulation and expression so you don’t have to worry about going back and forth. I love this pump, and highly recommend!
I’ve had this for over a month now and can say this pump is easily the best one on the market. It used to take me over 40 minutes of pumping to be fully empty, but with the heating and vibration features of the Wellness 1 pump it now takes me less than 30 minutes. I also love that I can look down and actively see my mil

k output, and one charge last a long time. These are worth every penny!
Best investment ever, I mean I wouldnt pay $400 for it but I caught it on a sale and Im so glad I got it! I didnt know pumping didnt have to be torture. The temperature added heat makes it soothing, now the massage is just a vibration but it still helps as well.I had the M5 before which wasnt bad as well but I def havent used it since this one arrived.
